statement: The record shows invoice 88412 was already paid in full under reference PAY-2291 despite its current “unpaid” status, so the prudent value is avoiding a duplicate USD 148,300 payment.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts the "unpaid" status is contradicted by the record's own payment history ("already paid in full under reference PAY-2291 despite its current 'unpaid' status"), identifying the duplicate USD 148,300 payment risk.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
